dedupe_keys.name: indice de capacidad de acogida del territorio para energia fotovoltaica

description: Índice de capacidad de acogida del territorio para energía fotovoltaica is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by idem.comunidad.madrid. Raster layer with a pixel size of 25 x 25 m in which the value of a representative index of the capacity of the territory of the Community of Madrid to host photovoltaic installations (solar panels) is represented. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Index of reception capacity of the territory for photovoltaic energy" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Flora, Paneles solares, Urbanismo, Comunidad de Madrid, Medio Ambiente, Medio Rural. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.es). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
